devnet_status.highlight: PQ devnet-0 stable after resolving XMSS key-loading/caching issues; devnet-1 launched mid-call with all 8 CL clients participating
devnet-1 differs from devnet-0 by adding staggered aggregations, expected from every client; monitoring via DORA coming soon
Barnabas proposes AB comparison with Waggle at same node count as devnet-1 to measure bandwidth reduction

leanvm_performance.highlight: LeanVM v0.19 is current release; 16-to-1 recursion on NUC 14 Pro at 4 cores = 2.2s idle, ~3s under EVM load
Committee size has <10% impact on 16-to-1 recursion time; proposal to use small committees with 16 of them in future devnets to get representative recursion numbers
If LeanVM needs 2x speedup, options are: reduce DVT-friendliness (1.5x gain), add top-layer caching/pre-aggregation, or pivot to DC

staking_contracts.highlight: Pre-registry contract has all pieces in place; open questions on system-contract architecture need EF/Steel input before auditing can begin
XMSS spec freeze (end of January) is the main blocker for auditing XMSS verification bytecode; queuing contracts can be audited sooner
Estimated 4 months to mainnet deployment of pre-registry contract; LightClient and Steel teams flagged for internal audit review
Voluntary exits moving to EL: same message semantics as current voluntary exits, triggered via contract rather than CL P2P

networking_simulations.highlight: Simulations (Csaba, Kamil, Anton) aim to answer: does current spec work on mainnet-realistic conditions via gossip-sub and alternatives?
General consensus: gossip-sub baseline likely insufficient; Kamil's simulations show simpler segmented-broadcast approaches perform comparably or better than zcast with less complexity
Two implementation tracks exist: zcast over gossip (Silver + Prysm) and segmented broadcast over Waggle (Lighthouse + Teku); proposal to run separate devnets for each and compare proof propagation

organizational.highlight: Friday PQ-CL call removed; cadence drops from 3 to 2 calls per week; next call Tuesday with Justin Traglia facilitating

action_items.action: Ping LightClient and Steel teams to begin internal audit of pre-registry system contract (non-XMSS portions)
Csaba, Kamil, Anton, and jxs to cross-validate simulation results and publish unified findings by Friday
Networking teams (Vlad, Kamil, Csaba) to agree async today on which segmented-broadcast protocol to test in next devnet

decisions.decision: PQ specs considered stable; no changes needed to answer the PQ-Casper vs DC question
Friday PQ-CL breakout call removed; moving to 2 calls per week
Next devnet will add segmented proof broadcast (zcast-over-gossip or equivalent) on top of devnet-1 spec; aggregation proofs only, everything else remains on gossip-sub
